root: ^Ah, Mr. Wade Kim, welcome to the I.M.A. I'm Miss Maggie.

Start: ^You're our newest recruit. Big step, joining the I.M.A. We don’t take just anyone. You must have impressed someone.

c-1: ^No time to waste, huh? I like that. But first, we need to see if you’ve got what it takes.

Briefing: ^Let’s get you up to speed. The Information Monitoring Agency (I.M.A.) —that’s us—deals with intelligence, deceptive narratives, and keeping the world from falling apart. It’s a big job, and you’re now part of it.

c-1: ^More than that. We track, analyze, and neutralize harmful information before it spreads. And sometimes... well, sometimes we handle things more directly.

Continue: ^Alright, time to see what you’re made of. See that arcade machine over there? Go interact with it—you’ll get a code. Then, use the console beside it to input the code. That’ll send you straight to the training grounds.
^Pass the test, and you’re in. Fail… and, well, let’s not think about that. Prove yourself, Agent.
